messages:
alex.k: We're finalizing the pen-test retest window for KMS / RBAC evidence handoff. Vendor asked for a 4h window to validate mitigations and replay a couple of exploit traces. Need to lock access windows, confirm audit exports, and decide whether we rotate keys or grant ephemeral access. Availability next Tue/Wed. Who can own key rotation, audit exports, and attest to ephemeral roles?

maria.g: Tue 09:00-13:00 UTC works for me. I can own the grant creation + evidence package. Will need a short runbook from infra for ephemeral creds and the whitelist IPs.

jamal: prefer not to rotate prod CMKs for a retest. Suggest creating a time-limited KMS grant or scoped IAM role for decrypt-only on specific key ARNs. What exact logs do they need? CloudTrail + KMS usage logs + RBAC change events should cover it.

sarah.ops: agree with jamal. I have an authn script to create ephemeral creds via our IdP for up to 6h (ok for a 4h window). I'll also open a temporary firewall rule for the vendor IP range. Can someone confirm vendor egress IPs?

infra-bot: Created ticket SEC-2026 (access-window + evidence export). Assigned to maria.g and jamal.

pt-assessor: For retest evidence we need: list of key IDs and aliases, CloudTrail export (last 90 days), KMS key policy history, key rotation events, and a read-only snapshot of the S3 evidence bucket (object list + versions). We do not require key material — just the metadata and ability to validate usage. For active decrypt tests we need temporary decrypt call access.

alex.k: Good. Maria, please produce an evidence checklist containing exact files + queries we export. Also confirm what we will grant: temporary KMS grant or scoped IAM role. Tagging jamal for RBAC audit export. Need a point-of-contact for incident escalation during the window.

maria.g: Will produce checklist. Proposed exports: 
- CloudTrail: export lookup for events with "kms" and "Decrypt" in the last 90d
- KMS: key rotation and CreateGrant/DeleteGrant history for targeted keys
- CloudWatch logs: filter for kms-usage logs and failed decrypts
- IAM: credential/report of role/permission changes for last 30d
- S3 evidence bucket: list-objects + get-object permissions for the evidence snapshot

I'll also create a pre-signed manifest file with grant IDs and a short README for the vendor.

jamal: Example CloudWatch Insights query to surface failed decrypts (share with vendor):
```
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter message like /Decrypt/ and message like /FAILED/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 50
```
Note: we should mask any PII in logs before handoff.

pt-assessor: That query is fine. For decrypt tests we prefer a KMS grant with explicit GrantConstraints limiting to kms:Decrypt on these ARNs: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345 and similar. Time-limit the grant using CreateGrant + GrantTokens tied to the vendor principal.

maria.g: I'll create a grant via kms.create-grant scoped to the vendor's principal and set an explicit RetireGrantAfter (we don't have that exact param, will schedule a manual retire after window). I'll include the grant id in the manifest. For extra safety we'll scope it to a specific key-usage (decrypt only) and attach kms:ViaService condition to limit calls from our lambda VPC endpoints if possible.

jamal: Also add IAM condition to deny transitive access and ensure the role cannot call kms:CreateGrant or kms:PutKeyPolicy. Only Decrypt and Describe allowed.

sarah.ops: Scheduling: propose Tue 2026-03-24 14:00-18:00 UTC for the vendor. Maria, can you have the manifest + grants ready by Mon 2026-03-23 EOD UTC? I'll open the firewall window and coordinate with oncall.

alex.k: oncall escalation: primary pager is oncall@redwood.io, backup is sec-ops@redwood.io. Add myself (alex.k) as contact for vendor questions.

maria.g: Confirmed — will deliver manifest, grant IDs, and bucket snapshot by Mon EOD. I'll also include a short README with the exact S3 paths and sample aws-cli commands to download the exports.

jamal: One more note: if the vendor needs to perform replay tests that include replaying encrypted payloads, we should require them to run tests in our isolated staging VPC where we can route traffic through our logging hooks. Production keys should not be used in replay scenarios.

pt-assessor: Ok — we'll accept staging test with scoped keys. If production metadata is required for validation, we only need CloudTrail + KMS usage records. We won't request key material.

alex.k: Action items summary: 
- maria.g: manifest + grant IDs + S3 snapshot (due Mon EOD)
- jamal: define minimal IAM policy and RBAC export queries (PR to infra runbook)
- sarah.ops: open firewall window + schedule retest (Tue 2026-03-24 14:00-18:00 UTC)
- infra-bot: link SEC-2026 ticket to evidence exports and runbook

maria.g: tagging final checklist items here — will post the manifest link once uploaded to the secure share. :thumbsup:

sarah.ops: I'll also coordinate a quick 15m pre-window call with vendor + our oncall 30m before start.

alex.k: Thanks all. If anything changes ping this thread.

infra-bot: SEC-2026 updated: evidence-bucket prepared (s3://redwood-pen-test-evidence/2026-03-24/), grant placeholder created, firewall rule scheduled.

maria.g: Manifest uploaded to secure share: https://share.internal.redwood/sec/manifest-1769567890.pdf — contains key IDs, grant ids, and export file checksums.

jamal: I'll open a PR for the RBAC export queries and link to this thread.

pt-assessor: Received manifest and will confirm final vendor schedule tomorrow. Thanks everyone.
